Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
* Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
* Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title: Technical Project Coordinator**

**Location**: Gomti Nagar, Lucknow

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time

**Experience**: 1–3 years (preferably in a tech/software environment)

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organised and detail\-oriented **Technical Project Coordinator** to bridge the gap between clients and our development team. You will be responsible for gathering client requirements, facilitating smooth communication between stakeholders, ensuring proper documentation, coordinating project tasks, testing deliverables, and managing post\-delivery client interactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirement Gathering \& Analysis**

* Conduct client meetings to understand their business requirements.
* Document technical and functional requirements clearly and comprehensively.
* Translate client needs into actionable tasks for the development team.

**Team Coordination \& Facilitation**

* Act as a communication bridge between clients and developers.
* Provide the development team with all necessary resources—access credentials, API keys, SDKs, mockups, etc.
* Share detailed error logs, screenshots, or video recordings with relevant team members for faster resolution.
* Clarify any ambiguities raised by the technical team regarding features or requirements.

**Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) for all completed modules before client handover.
* Ensure that all deliverables align with initial requirements and are free from critical bugs.
* Maintain a checklist or testing document for each project milestone.

**Client Support \& Enhancements**

* Coordinate with clients post\-deployment for issues, bug reports, or enhancement requests.
* Collect, document, and prioritise change requests and forward them to the development team.
* Ensure timely resolution and communicate progress with clients clearly and professionally.

**Project Tracking \& Reporting**

* Maintain project timelines and ensure deliverables are met as per schedule.
* Use project management tools like Trello, Asana, or Jira to track progress.
* Provide regular status updates to internal teams and clients.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Proven experience in client communication and technical coordination.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with bug tracking and QA/testing processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of APIs, Web/Mobile app workflows.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Canva, Postman, Jira, Notion, or similar.
* Basic testing skills and experience writing test cases and writing build release notes.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with a fast\-growing tech company delivering impactful software solutions.
* Be the voice of the client inside the tech team and ensure project excellence.
* Opportunity to grow into a Project Lead or Manager role based on performance.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent, Fresher

Pay: ₹120,000\.00 \- ₹180,000\.00 per year

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Support Technical Engineer
description:
Support Technical Engineer responsible for configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and day\-to\-day support of IoT devices and related systems. Ensures smooth device operations, timely issue resolution, and coordination with internal teams and clients.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Configure and deploy IoT devices as per project requirements
* Perform device installation, testing, and commissioning at site or remotely
* Monitor device performance and ensure continuous connectivity
* Diagnose and troubleshoot hardware, firmware, and network\-related issues
* Work on Linux\-based systems for device access, configuration, and debugging (basic level)
* Access devices via SSH and perform basic command\-line operations where required
* Maintain logs of issues, resolutions, and daily activities
* Provide technical support to clients via call, email, or remote access
* Coordinate with development team for bug fixes and improvements
* Handle SIM/network configuration, IP settings, and server connectivity
* Perform firmware upgrades and device health checks periodically
* Maintain inventory records of devices, accessories, and spares
* Assist in documentation, SOP (Standard Operating Procedures), and reports
* Support field engineers and guide them on technical issues
* Ensure adherence to company processes and timelines


**Required Skills**


* Basic understanding of IoT systems and device communication
* Knowledge of networking concepts (IP, TCP/IP, SIM\-based connectivity)
* Familiarity with hardware troubleshooting and serial communication
* Basic knowledge of Linux operating system (commands, file system, SSH access) – preferred but not mandatory
* Ability to use remote tools and diagnostic software
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms and APIs (Application Programming Interface)
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Strong communication and coordination abilities


**Educational Qualification**


* Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or related field


**Experience**


* 0–2 years of experience in technical support / IoT / embedded systems (Freshers can apply)


**Other Requirements**


* Willingness to travel for site visits if required
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and reporting


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**


* Issue resolution time
* Device uptime and performance
* Number of successful deployments
* Customer satisfaction

· Monitoring CCTV equipment functionality and report technical issues promptly.

· Staying updated on parking regulations and ensuring all the actions align with legal requirements.

· Providing clear and informative responses to customer inquiries regarding parking regulations and policies.

The ideal candidate working as a **Quality Assurance Analyst\- CCTV** will display:

· Bachelor's degree in a relevant field preferred

· Strong observational skills and attention to detail

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

· Ability to work independently and as part of a team

· Proficiency in English (both written and verbal)

Required Qualification:

· Bachelor’s degree in any discipline is preferred.

· Fresher to 2 years of experience in relevant field.

· Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Benefits of working as a **Quality Assurance Analyst\- CCTV** with **Indus Parking Services**:

**Key responsibilities:**

**1\. Recruitment \& Onboarding:**

* Coordinate the recruitment process, including job posting, screening resumes, scheduling interviews (Virtual or in\-person), and conducting initial interviews.
* Manage the end\-to\-end onboarding process for new hires, including documentation, orientation, and induction training.
* Identify and work with reputable recruitment agencies to source candidates for specialized roles. Negotiate favorable terms and conditions with external recruitment agencies, including fee structure and timelines.
* Provide clear feedback to candidates, whether successful or unsuccessful, ensuring a positive image of the company is maintained.

**2\. Employee Relations:**

* Address employee queries regarding HR policies, procedures, and benefits.
* Support the development and implementation of employee engagement activities and programs.
* Foster a culture of open communication where employees feel comfortable voicing their ideas, suggestions, or concerns.
* Conducting Cultural Events and Activities such as Annual Events, Festivals \& Celebrations, Team\-Building Activities and Wellness Programs for employees.
* Collaborate with department heads and managers to identify training needs based on performance evaluations and team feedback. Organizing Training Programs such as internal training, external training and E\-Learning \& Online Platforms.
* Assist in conflict resolution and handle workplace grievances.

**3\. HR Policies \& Procedures:**

* Assist in the development, implementation, and updating of HR policies and employee handbooks. Ensure that all HR policies are documented and stored in an easily accessible location, such as the company’s Ons drive. Create clear, user\-friendly handbooks or manuals that employees can refer to.
* Ensure consistent application of policies and provide guidance on best HR practices.
* Ensure transparency and clear communication regarding HR policies, procedures, and any organizational changes.
* Develop comprehensive onboarding training sessions to familiarize new hires with company processes, culture, tools, and expectations.

**4\. Compensation \& Employee Data management:**

* Maintain the company’s assets management file.
* Monitor employee attendances and regularize it and generating warnings and memos
* Administering compensation and benefit plans for employees
* Ensure that the company complies with labor laws and statutory regulations (PF, ESIC etc.).
* Develop SOPs for common HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, disciplinary actions, and terminations.

**5\. Performance Management:**

* Coordinate employee development programs to enhance skills and productivity.
* Help develop performance improvement plans and follow up on corrective actions.

Rak's Pallikkoodam subscribes to the 21st century learning principles and is a student\-centered, future\-focused, coeducational day school. Creativity and Critical thinking, combined with developing the strength of character is at the core of our programme. The school is also grounded in the 21st\-century educational principles. For more information, please visit https://www.rakspallikkoodam.com/

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

The Technical Administrator is responsible for managing and maintaining the school's technical infrastructure, including hardware, software, and networking systems. Your role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of all technical resources to support teaching, learning, and administrative functions within the school. This role requires excellent organizational ability, multi\-tasking skills and work hour flexibility.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee the installation, configuration, and maintenance of all hardware components, including servers, desktops, laptops, printers, and other peripherals.
* Install, update, and maintain software applications used by students, teachers, and administrative staff.
* Ensure the proper functioning of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues to minimize downtime and ensure optimal performance.
* Conduct regular backups of data and implement disaster recovery procedures.
* Provide technical support and assistance to users encountering software\-related issues; Evaluate new software solutions and make recommendations to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for software licensing, support, and maintenance agreements.
* Install, configure, and maintain CCTV cameras and associated equipment to ensure effective surveillance coverage throughout the school premises.
* Monitor live feeds and review recorded footage to enhance security and investigate incidents as needed.
* Conduct regular inspections and maintenance of CCTV equipment to ensure proper functioning.
* Implement and maintain security measures to protect the school's IT infrastructure from unauthorized access, viruses, and other security threats.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and best practices for handling sensitive information; Monitor network traffic and implement access controls to safeguard data integrity and confidentiality.
* Educate the staff on cybersecurity best practices and conduct training sessions as needed.
* Maintain an inventory of IT assets, including hardware, software licenses, warranty information and peripherals; and coordinate repair or replacement as needed.
* Coordinate the procurement of new equipment and software, ensuring compatibility with existing systems and budgetary constraints.

**Requirements:**

* **Must have** **good English communication skills**
* **Must be extremely tech\-savvy.** Substantial experience in similar or related roles. **Must have at least 4\-5 years of experience in a school environment.**
* Must be matured, dedicated and able to multi task.
* Must have the ability to work with a high level of accuracy, work methodically and on their own initiative, manage time effectively and take a solution\-focused approach at all times and the ability to maintain accurate and up\-to\-date data.
* Should have an innovative and creative approach to problem solving. Should be sharp, decisive and diplomatic.
* Should be flexible to work before or after school hours or during off\-days.
* Should be able to maintain a healthy professional relationship with management, teachers and colleagues.

Applications **without relevant qualification and experience** are requested **NOT TO APPLY** and will not be considered. **Freshers** are requested **NOT to apply.** The candidates are requested **NOT TO CALL THE SCHOOL**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Operations Manager — AI\-Powered** Chess Gaja · Madurai · Full\-time ₹28,000 \- 30,000/month \| Monday–Saturday \| 9:00 AM–6:00 PM \| In\-person only

**About Chess Gaja**

Chess Gaja is a global online chess academy serving students across 40\+ countries, with approximately 175 active students and a lean team of 9\. Our Madurai office is where strategy is made. We need one more person in this room — someone who runs operations end\-to\-end, solo, without being told what to do next.

**What This Role Actually Is**

You are not a coordinator. You are not an assistant. You are the person who makes sure the business runs — every day, without gaps. The founders focus on growth and product. You own everything operational.

If a parent in the US flags a billing error on a Friday evening, you fix it before Monday. If a remote team member goes quiet, you notice before the founders do. If a process is broken, you document and repair it — unprompted.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Zoho One ownership** — CRM, LMS, and Desk. You manage the data, the workflows, and the reports. If it's not in Zoho, it didn't happen.
* **Global billing and revenue protection** — Track renewals, resolve payment issues across 40\+ countries, and ensure zero revenue leakage every billing cycle.
* **Remote team accountability** — Be the operational hub between the Madurai office and 7 remote team members. Decisions made in this room must become results — fast.
* **International client communication** — Manage professional correspondence with parents across the US, Europe, and Asia. Written English must be polished and professional.
* **SOP documentation and process improvement** — Build the operating manual for Chess Gaja. If a process exists only in someone's head, your job is to put it on paper and make it repeatable.
* **Lead conversion and student onboarding** — High\-intent leads filtered by our chatbot system arrive directly to you on WhatsApp. Using structured templates and good judgment, you convert warm enquiries into enrolled students and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. This is consultative, not pushy — the lead is already interested, your job is to close the gap.

**The Non\-Negotiables**

* **You use AI tools daily.** ChatGPT, Claude, or similar — not as experiments, but as actual work tools. If you are not already doing this, this role is not for you.
* **You work independently.** There is no manager checking your task list. You identify what needs to be done, you do it, and you flag only what genuinely needs a decision.
* **You are technology\-comfortable.** CRM systems, Google Sheets, WhatsApp automation, payment gateways — you either know these or you figure them out quickly.
* **4\-6 years of real operations experience.** Fresher applicants will not be considered. We need someone who has already made mistakes elsewhere and learned from them.
* **You are a confident, clear communicator in writing.** A significant part of this role is converting warm international leads over WhatsApp. You don't need a sales background — but you must be able to read a conversation, respond with the right template at the right moment, and know when to go off\-script.
* **Based in Madurai, long\-term.** This is not a remote role. You must be here, in person, Monday to Saturday.
* You must bring your own laptop and smartphone to work daily. This is a condition of employment, not a preference.

**What Makes You Stand Out**

These are not required — but candidates who have them will move to the top of our list:

* Prior experience in an edtech company in any operational, administrative, or coordination role
* Basic knowledge of chess — you don't need to play competitively, but understanding the world we operate in helps you serve our families better
* Familiarity with Zoho One, specifically CRM
* Experience managing international clients or cross\-timezone communication

**Who We Expect to Apply**

Professionals returning to Madurai from Chennai or Bangalore who want the intensity of a startup without relocating again. Local high\-achievers who are under\-utilised in their current role and want real ownership of a global operation.

In today's market — where AI is replacing execution\-only roles — this is the kind of role that builds skills that remain valuable. You will learn how a global digital business actually runs, sitting next to the people who built it.

**Important Terms**

* 3\-month probation period applies upon joining
* Post\-probation: 2\-month notice period required for resignation
* Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM, in\-person at our Madurai office
* Immediate joiners preferred

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹28,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gomathipuram, Madurai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you play Chess? If yes, please provide your Chess.com/Lichess username and current rating. (Type 'No' if you don't play)
* This role requires you to be in our Madurai office Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 6 PM, with your own laptop and smartphone, starting immediately. Confirm you meet all three conditions. Type Yes or No — do not explain.

title: Manager, Technical Writer
description:
**About WebEngage**
 WebEngage is a leading B2B SaaS Customer Data and Engagement Platform that empowers consumer businesses to deliver personalized experiences at scale. The platform unifies customer data, automates lifecycle marketing, and orchestrates omnichannel engagement across digital touchpoints including email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications, in\-app messaging, and web channels.
   

  

 Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Mumbai, WebEngage serves hundreds of global brands across industries such as e\-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. The company has a strong presence across India, the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Southeast Asia.
   

  

 Learn more about us at www.webengage.com
   

  

**Job Description**
 We're looking for a Manager, Technical Writer, to lead and grow our documentation function. You'll own the strategy, standards, and delivery of all technical content — from product and API documentation to developer guides and in\-app help.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Team \& People**
* Build, mentor, and manage a team of technical writers; own hiring, onboarding, workload distribution, and career growth
* Set clear goals and provide regular feedback; coach writers to raise the bar on clarity, accuracy, and structure
* Foster a culture of documentation\-first thinking across the product and engineering org


**Documentation Strategy \& Delivery**
* Own the documentation roadmap aligned to WebEngage's product releases across channels — Push, Email, WhatsApp, Journey Designer, Data Platform, and more
* Ensure timely, accurate, and complete coverage across all content types: user guides, API/SDK docs, release notes, integration guides, onboarding flows, and knowledge base articles
* Drive adoption of a docs\-as\-code workflow using version control, structured authoring, and continuous publishing


**Standards \& Governance**
* Define and maintain WebEngage's documentation style guide, taxonomy, and content governance framework
* Conduct regular content audits; track documentation health via coverage, freshness, and usage metrics
* Establish review processes with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to keep documentation current through rapid release cycles


**Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to embed documentation into the product development lifecycle
* Work closely with Customer Success, Support, and Solutions teams to identify gaps from real customer pain points
* Collaborate with the Marketing team on developer\-facing content, product announcements, and integration showcases on the WebEngage developer portal


**What We're Looking For**
* 6\-9 years of technical writing experience in a software product company
* Strong working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and SDK documentation; ability to read and interpret code (Python, JS, or similar)
* Proficiency with docs\-as\-code tools — Git, Markdown, and static site generators (MkDocs, Docusaurus, or similar)
* Experience with documentation platforms such as Confluence, Notion, ReadMe, or Zendesk Guide
* Excellent written communication; proven ability to simplify complex platform behaviour for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to align priorities across fast\-moving product and engineering teams


**Nice to have**
* Prior experience at a martech, analytics, or customer engagement platform.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted documentation tools or automated content workflows is a big plus.
* Familiarity with developer portal design, UX writing, or information architecture
* Understanding of customer lifecycle marketing concepts — segmentation, journeys, push/email/SMS channels
* Upload your portfolio here \- https://forms.gle/Y4xLv7GEskwqrF7b9


**Location \- Mumbai**
**Life At WebEngage**
* We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top\-level view across the board with our monthly \& quarterly town hall meetings.
* A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
* Practice autonomy, open communication, and growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work\-life balance

title: Team Member -Employee Relations- Kolkata
description:
**Job Summary**
 The HR \- ER Compliance Manager – Zonal will be responsible for Employee Relations and compliance across assigned branches within the zone for the Gold Loans business. The role ensures adherence to statutory labour laws, company policies, audit requirements, and ethical HR practices. The incumbent must be comfortable with frequent travel to branches for audits, investigations, and compliance monitoring.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:** 
**1\. HR Operations \& Compliance**
* Ensure 100% statutory compliance across branches (Shops \& Establishment Act, Minimum Wages, Bonus, Gratuity, PF, ESI, CLRA, POSH, etc.).
* Conduct periodic HR compliance audits across branches.
* Maintain updated compliance trackers and documentation.
* Coordinate with legal and compliance teams for statutory filings and inspections.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR and labour compliance.


**2\. Employee Relations (ER)**
* Manage employee grievance handling and resolution within defined timelines.
* Conduct disciplinary inquiries and domestic investigations where required.
* Support HRBP in handling misconduct, absenteeism, and performance issues.
* Ensure proper documentation of warning letters, charge sheets, and termination processes.
* Promote a positive employee relations climate across the zone.
* Monitor adherence to code of conduct and ethical standards.
* Partner with Business HR to address Employee issues.
* Oversee background verification and employee documentation.


**3\. POSH \& Workplace Conduct**
* Ensure compliance with POSH regulations across branches.
* Support IC inquiries and conduct awareness sessions.


**4\. Travel \& Field Engagement**
* Conduct regular branch visits across the assigned zone.
* Perform surprise compliance checks and employee engagement meetings.
* Be available for urgent ER matters and statutory inspections.


**Key Skills \& Competencies:**
* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience in Employee Relations and disciplinary processes.
* Investigation and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong documentation and audit management skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the zone.

You’ll handle issues on operation management, strategic partnership, employee relations and emergency responding.
   

  

 To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose\-led and values\-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.
   

  

 As a Manager, You'll Work As Part Of a Team Of Problem Solvers, Helping To Solve Complex Business Issues From Strategy To Execution. PwC Professional Skills And Responsibilities For This Management Level Include But Are Not Limited To:
   

  

* Develop new skills outside of comfort zone.
* Act to resolve issues which prevent the team working effectively.
* Coach others, recognise their strengths, and encourage them to take ownership of their personal development.
* Analyse complex ideas or proposals and build a range of meaningful recommendations.

* Develop a point of view on key global trends, and how they impact clients.

 The Opportunity
   

  

 When you join PwC Acceleration Centers (ACs), you step into a pivotal role focused on actively supporting various Acceleration Center services, from Advisory to Assurance, Tax and Business Services. In our innovative hubs, you’ll engage in challenging projects and provide distinctive services to support client engagements through enhanced quality and innovation. You’ll also participate in dynamic and digitally enabled training that is designed to grow your technical and professional skills.

As a Manager you are expected to supervise, develop, and coach teams, manage client service accounts, and drive assigned client engagement workstreams by supervising teams and independently solving and analyzing complex problems to develop top\-quality deliverables. * Serving as a trusted advisor to partners and leaders

* Mentoring and developing junior staff to enhance their skills
* Ensuring project success by maintaining elevated standards
* Motivating and inspiring team members to deliver quality work
* Collaborating with partners to identify and address issues
* Implementing action plans for diversity and development
* Demonstrating leadership and accountability in every task


 What You Must Have
   

  

* High School Diploma
* 4 years of Human Capital or PwC Experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree preferred
* PHR or SPHR Certification
* Serving as a trusted advisor to partners/leaders
* Collaborating on people strategy including diversity and development
* Leading potential talent and succession planning
* Developing reliable relationships with staff
* Focusing on diversity initiatives with partners/leaders

* Applying coaching skills to increase effectiveness

title: Process Associate- Fresher
description:
**Job Title:** Process Associate (Fresher)  

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  

**Company:** Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Us**
------------


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable Healthcare Management partner. With several years of experience, we have perfected our end\-to\-end services in medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare operations.


We provide services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based Healthcare Company. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous growth drives our success. As we expand, we are seeking enthusiastic and responsible **freshers** to join our team as Process Associates.

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The Process Associate (Fresher) will support employee attendance tracking, workplace monitoring, and operational documentation. This is an entry\-level role suitable for candidates who are willing to learn, follow company policies, and work closely with HR, IT, and Security teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Attendance Monitoring**

* Assist in tracking daily employee attendance.
* Support verification of punctuality, absences, and late arrivals.
* Help generate daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports.
* Share reports with HR and management teams.

### **CCTV \& Surveillance Support**

* Assist in monitoring CCTV systems to ensure workplace safety.
* Report suspicious activities or issues to the concerned team.
* Maintain basic logs of surveillance recordings.

### **Login/Logout Monitoring**

* Support tracking of employee login and logout times.
* Maintain shift\-wise working hour records.
* Identify basic discrepancies and report them to HR.

### **Alarm \& Access Control Support**

* Assist in maintaining alarm system codes and access permissions.
* Update access lists under supervision.
* Follow security procedures as per company policy.

### **Operational Support**

* Assist HR and Operations teams with attendance\-related tasks.
* Maintain records related to attendance and employee logs.
* Support onboarding activities such as system access setup.
* Assist during audits when required.

### **Reporting \& Documentation**

* Maintain organized records of attendance and login/logout data.
* Prepare reports under supervision.
* Provide required documents during internal reviews.

### **Support \& Coordination**

* Coordinate with HR, IT, and Security teams as needed.
* Provide support to employees regarding attendance queries.
* Follow instructions from supervisors and management.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Mandatory)**
* **Freshers are welcome to apply**
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, MS Word)
* Good communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Willingness to learn and work in night shifts
* High level of integrity and confidentiality

**Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion**
--------------------------------------


Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization and foster an inclusive culture where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

**Work Schedule \& Benefits**
-----------------------------

* Competitive salary (including EPF and ESIC)
* Health insurance
* Four\-day work week (Monday – Thursday)
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* Food and cab\-drop facilities available
* **Night Shift:** 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM
* **Work Mode:** Work From Office only

**Application Process**
-----------------------


Please submit your resume detailing your academic background and interest in this role.


For any queries, please contact:  

 recruitment@hupcfl.com  

 7780502143

**Note:** Candidates are requested to contact between **4:45 PM to 3:45 AM IST, Monday through Thursday.**

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Engineer, the Networks tower manages globally the life cycle, delivery, quality and performance of the Wide Area Network, the internet connections, network management, Firewall, Security, (W)LAN, DNS/DHCP and all other aspects of connectivity for Nokia Networks offices and partners. Support the digital transformation and the use of cloud services. Responsible for IT service management handling Incident management, Problem management, Change management for all IT network technologies. Work on technical design, functionality, configuration, performance and quality of connectivity. This is a position in network service delivery for enabling reliable service delivery for IT network services.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Follow troubleshooting mechanisms stated in SOPs and suggest corrective action or capture logs
* Work in 24x7 support model and provide required shift handover
* Create incident ticket for device alerts for non\-auto\-ticketing alerts, triage and escalate
* Execute low critical service requests based on the SOPs
* Own incident ticket resolution end\-to\-end and co\-ordinations
* Coordinate with cross\-functional technology technical team to resolve the incident
* Track intermediate issue until its closure working with multiple stakeholder
* Follow the problem mgmt. process to get the root cause and problem task closure
* Engage WAN service provider/Vendor/TAC to troubleshoot the issue and escalate to get is resolved
* Additional duties as required and possible remote implementation assistance on special projects
* Helping in ticket management and reporting task
* Hands \& eye support co\-ordination and vendor dispatch


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Bachelor's degree or engineering degree in Telecommunications/Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent
* Good understanding of network technologies: TCP/IP, VRRP, DNS, ARP, STP, Trunking, Port Channeling, VRF, IPsec, and TLS
* Familiar with routing protocols such as OSPF, ISIS, BGP, Route Policy, QoS, VRRP, Multicast, LDP, and MPLS
* Knowledge in all network productions router, switches and Firewall..etc
* Must have a strong understanding on the basics of network communication like TCP/IP
* Sound knowledge of IP addressing, DHCP \& DNS, various routing \& switching protocols like OSPF, BGP, VRRP, STP etc.
* Sound knowledge of various WAN connectivity models like SDWAN, MPLS, Point to Point etc, wireless communications and its components like access points and controllers
* Sound knowledge of security protocols and concepts like IPsec, SSL VPN, ACL, NAT etc, at least one of the public cloud concepts from Azure, GCP, AWS etc.
* Must have an anything automate attitude \& the required skillset to understand the technical requirements and develop network automation for various deployments and strong presentation skill in documenting the high\-level and low\-level network design
* Ability to provide an operational support for the deployed solutions and administer incidents, problems, service requests and changes in line with ITIL practices
* Ability to coordinate with cross\-functional technical team \& stake holder management in getting our tasks achieved and engage with Customers, Partners, Vendors \& service provider wherever needed


**Nice\-To\-Have:**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Eager and capable to work in a global multi\-cultural team
* Strong customer focus
* Drive to deliver results, “get things done” attitude


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .

 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working schemes
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave, with the option to return to work within a year following the birth or adoption of a child (based on eligibility)
* Life insurance to all employees to provide peace of mind and financial security
* Well\-being programs to support your mental and physical health
* Opportunities to join and receive support from Nokia Employee Resource Groups (NERGs)
* Employee Growth Solutions to support your personalized career \& skills development
* Diverse pool of Coaches \& Mentors to whom you have easy access
* A learning environment which promotes personal growth and professional development \- for your role and beyond

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Your IT Future, Delivered.
   

  

 Senior Network Engineer (NOC)
   

  

 With a global team of 5600\+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services connects people and keeps the global economy running by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions. We work beyond global borders and push boundaries across all dimensions of logistics. You can leave your mark shaping the technology backbone of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the \#GreatPlaceToWork certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experiences.
   

  

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**
 At IT Services, we are passionate about network technology. Our Network Operations Center team is continuously expanding. No matter your level of your proficiency, you can always grow within our diverse environment.
   

  

*\#DHL \#DHLITServices \#GreatPlace*
**Grow together.**
 As a Senior Network Engineer in DHL India Telecom Team, you will play a critical role in maintaining the stability and performance of DHL’s network infrastructure spread across multiple business units in India. Your primary responsibility is to monitor, identify, and escalate issues affecting business\-critical services across technologies such as LAN, WAN \& Wireless LAN.
   

  

 In addition to operational duties, you will contribute to service improvement by analyzing recurring issues and providing feedback and recommendations to help optimize network performance, reduce operational risk, and enhance overall service delivery. This includes identifying patterns, proposing configuration improvements, and collaborating with engineering and architecture teams. You will also mentor junior engineers and support knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 This position requires a blend of deep technical knowledge, strong analytical thinking, and effective communication skills. You will work closely with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure that DHL’s network infrastructure remains robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
   

  

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what you will do**
* Lead and coordinate incident resolution for Telecom infrastructure.
* Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for LAN, WAN (SDWAN, MPLS) \& WLAN.
* Provide interim and permanent solutions for business\-critical incidents.
* Analyze incident trends and network capacity for proactive planning.
* Participate in change management processes.
* Monitor and resolve infrastructure events impacting service quality.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers.
* Demonstrate ownership and accountability in all assigned tasks.
* Responsible for documentation and updating internal processes within the team.


**What you should have:**
* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
* 10 years of hands\-on experience in Telecoms or Network Operations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).
* CCNP Network Certification.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Cisco switching/routing, and wireless LAN.
* Familiarity with firewall (FW), intrusion prevention (NIPS), F5 load balancing and Proxy.
* Excellent communication, prioritization, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* ITIL Foundation.


**An array of benefits for you:**
* Hybrid work arrangements to balance in\-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* Medical Insurance: Self \+ Spouse \+ 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent \-in\-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. description:
**Job overview**

Front\-end developers are integral to creating dynamic web applications and intuitive user interfaces. These professionals work closely with back\-end developers, UX/UI designers, and stakeholders to develop responsive and scalable solutions. Using frameworks like React, Vue, or AngularJS, they transform design wireframes and mockups into functional, high\-quality websites. A skilled front\-end web developer enhances usability, ensures cross\-browser compatibility and optimizes web pages for performance.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Developing user interfaces.** Build engaging and responsive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* **Collaborating with team members.** Work with UX/UI designers, back\-end developers, and stakeholders to create cohesive designs and functionality.
* **Implementing responsive design.** Optimize web pages for usability across devices, including desktops, tablets, and mobile phones.
* **Debugging and troubleshooting.** Identify and resolve functionality issues to ensure smooth user experiences.
* **Maintaining codebase.** Use version control systems like Git to manage and review reusable, clean, and efficient code.
* **Ensuring cross\-browser compatibility.** Test and fix compatibility issues in different browsers and environments.
* **Integrating APIs.** Connect front\-end interfaces with back\-end systems using RESTful APIs.
* **Creating prototypes.** Develop mockups and wireframes to visualize and refine design concepts.
* **Staying current.** Research and implement the latest industry trends and front\-end development technologies.

**Qualifications and skills**

* **Education.** A bachelor’s degree in technology, computer science, or a related field.
* **Experience. 6\-1** year of experience in front\-end development or similar roles.
* **Technical skills.** Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and frameworks like React, AngularJS, or Vue.
* **Communication skills.** Strong verbal and written communication skills are needed for effective collaboration with team members and stakeholders.
* **Problem\-solving.** Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills to resolve technical challenges.

* **Soft skills.** Teamwork, adaptability, and a proactive approach to project deadlines.

* Communicates and reports on the effectiveness of the firm’s governance, risk management and controls that mitigate current and evolving risk

* Assesses the firm’s control culture and conduct risks; and
* Monitors management’s implementation of control measures

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Title**
**Technical Writer / Senior Technical Writer**
**Position Overview**
 As a Technical Writer / Senior Technical Writer at LTSCT, you will be responsible for developing high\-quality product documentation that supports semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware solutions. This role requires the ability to understand complex technical concepts—spanning semiconductor technologies, associated subsystems, and software/firmware workflows—and translate them into clear, concise, user\-focused content.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and globally distributed teams to gather information, structure documentation, and ensure consistency across deliverables. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong proficiency in structured authoring (DITA), single\-sourcing methodologies, and documentation lifecycle management using CCMS platforms. This role demands excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while consistently meeting deadlines.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Create complete, high\-quality product documentation from the ground up, adhering to organizational standards and project timelines.
* Update documentation to reflect changes in product versions, features, specifications, and industry standards.
* Use structured authoring methodologies (e.g., DITA) to create reusable content modules.
* Maintain a single source of truth for documentation to support consistent outputs across multiple formats.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Quality teams to gather technical information and simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, accuracy, clarity, and technical correctness.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards such as IEEE, ISO, and JEDEC when documenting processes or specifications.
* Work effectively with both local and global teams across different time zones.
* Contribute to the development of standard diagrams, illustrations, videos, and presentations.
* Support special projects involving content review, proofreading, editing, and formatting for internal and external audiences.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably ECE, EEE, CSE), Technical Communication, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware documentation.
* Ability to design clear technical diagrams, architecture workflows, and visuals using Visio, Draw.io, or Adobe Illustrator.
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Exposure to documentation automation workflows (CI/CD publishing, Git branching, versioning pipelines, or scripted builds).
* Proven ability to manage documentation projects throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong experience with CCMS platforms and structured authoring methodologies to drive content reuse and maintain version control.


**Mandatory Skills**
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard documentation tools such as Oxygen XML Editor or equivalent XML/DITA\-based editors.
* Experience collaborating directly with SMEs such as design engineers, firmware developers, and validation teams to extract technical information.
* Hands\-on experience working with product engineering teams, understanding development lifecycles, sprints, and review workflows.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate technical content against design specifications, datasheets, and release notes.
* Strong command of English writing, editing, and technical communication standards.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience with CCMS\-based documentation tools, preferably Vasont Inspire.
* Experience writing and maintaining programming guides, user manuals, firmware guides, feature descriptions, and release documentation for semiconductors or SoC products.
* Experience documenting APIs, AT command sets, SDK workflows, or developer\-facing technical content.
* Familiarity with semiconductor terminology, chip architecture, block diagrams, and hardware development concepts.
* Knowledge of documentation automation, scripting, or Git\-based workflows.
* Ability to create multimedia content such as short videos, tutorials, or animations for product documentation.

 Structure solution narratives, commercial models, and delivery approaches that differentiate the offering. Drive thought leadership in client conversations and steer deal strategy in partnership with sales leaders. Consistently contribute to revenue growth, pipeline shaping, and account expansion.

 Develop accelerators, frameworks, templates, and reusable assets that elevate consulting quality and speed\-to\-solution. Author POVs, whitepapers, and industry insights to establish practice credibility. Represent the practice in internal and external forums as a strategic thinker.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Workday, founded in 2005, stands as a groundbreaking force in the human capital and financial management industry, with a global presence and a diverse array of customers. Across our offices worldwide, our teams are united by a shared dedication to innovation, collaboration, and excellence!
   

  

 Join our Web Service Frameworks team, which globally\-spans across Chennai (India), Dublin (Ireland) and Pleasanton (United States)! We are passionate about enabling Workday developers to build, publish, and maintain SOAP and REST APIs for their product areas. We value innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of ownership. We believe that mistakes are invaluable opportunities for growth, and we continuously learn from them to improve.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Do what you love. Love what you do.**
 At Workday, we help the world’s largest organizations adapt to what’s next by bringing finance, HR, and planning into a single enterprise cloud. We work hard, and we’re serious about what we do. But we like to have fun too. We put people first, celebrate diversity, drive innovation, and do good in the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**What does a Software Development Engineer do at Workday?**
* Designs and implements elegant, scalable and performant features and components in a team\-oriented environment
* Delivers high quality, well thought\-out features that keep Workday's application developers in mind
* Collaborates with team members by white\-boarding and working through ideas with constructive recommendations from the rest of the team and vice\-versa
* Shares knowledge via mentoring, reviews and technical discussions
* Introduces the team to new technologies, frameworks, and points of view


**Our Tech Stack**
* Java/JUnit
* XpressO (Workday proprietary)


**About You**
 Are you passionate about Web APIs? Are you interested in building the future framework to support Workday's SOAP and REST offerings? Do you consider yourself an advocate on the subject of Web APIs? Do you like sharing knowledge with your peers and inspiring creativity within your team? Do you enjoy attending meetups, hackathons and Dev Conferences? Then you sound like an ideal candidate to apply to our role with the Workday Web Services Frameworks team!
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of experience with object\-oriented design and programming with Java, including 1 year of REST APIs development experience.
* 3\+ years of experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.) and standard development tools and processes: source control, IDEs, frameworks, JUnit tests, debugging, issue trackers
* Demonstrated experience delivering projects by leveraging curiosity and collaboration in feature design
* Proven ability to share knowledge via formal mentoring, reviewing code, reviewing design docs, giving technical talks, teaching classes, or as a project consultant
* Competence in communicating design ideas cohesively using UML and presentations
* Ability to ask “what can I do to help?” to propel the team or technology forward without prompting


**Other Qualifications**
* 1\+ year of experience with other Web Services technologies (SOAP, XML/Schema, WSDL, XSLT, SAX, etc.)
* Bachelor's degree in a computer related field or equivalent work experience


**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
 With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply
 **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** 
 with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
   

  

 At Workday, we are committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience where all candidates can fully demonstrate their skills. If you require assistance or an accommodation at any point, please email accommodations@workday.com.
   

  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
 At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
   

  

 Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
   

  

 In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

 performance, and integrate data and backend services. Their problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and continuous learning mindset contribute to code quality and innovation.

Driving the targets of Direct Labour cost \& TPP, developing backups on redeployment matrix to impact on manpower productivity. Regular coordination with HR team on tracking unauthorized absenteeism and OT trend and ensuring effective communication to sustain good discipline.

Maximising TE/ NE, ensuring conversion efficiencies better than AOP and executing ideas on productivity – sharing views with sector SMEs for troubleshooting and capturing better productivity ideas implemented across other plants as a part of continuous improvement. * Planning and Reporting: Ensuring integrity of data entry across lines, monitoring the data on shift\-to\-shift basis and reporting of the all the numbers on daily basis in DW as per MNW guidance.

Conducting 1\-1 with the operatives, implementation of “Each one teach one” etc on the shop floor for the better engagement and building inclusive culture \& keeping the operation disruption free.

We are an automation company who offers Global clients Business Process Automation and Business Process Outsourcing services. We are seeking a high\-velocity Recruiter to anchor our India operations. This isn’t just a sourcing role; you will be the architect of our talent pipeline across Tier 1 hubs (NCR, Bangalore, Pune) and emerging Tier 2 satellites (Nashik, Vizag). You will manage a diverse desk ranging from campus interns to specialized AI developers and Finance analysts.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Strategic Sourcing:** Leverage your existing network in the Delhi\-NCR automation corridor and Maharashtra’s finance hubs to find “plug\-and\-play” talent.
* **Full\-Cycle Execution:** Own the hiring journey for technology (Python/RPA), finance (AP/AR/Bookkeeping), and high\-volume operations.
* **Market Mapping:** Advise leadership on regional “pockets of excellence” (e.g., sourcing AR analysts from Nashik vs. developers from Noida).
* **University Relations:** Build a sustainable pipeline by managing end\-to\-end campus recruitment at top\-tier engineering and commerce colleges.

**Success Metrics (Standard Industry KPIs)**
--------------------------------------------


We measure performance by precision, not just activity. You will be evaluated on:

* **Time\-to\-Fill (TTF):**
	+ Tech/Finance/Mid\-Level: \< 20 days
	+ Entry\-Level/Operations : \< 7 days
* **Offer Acceptance Rate (OAR):** Maintain a \> 85% benchmark through high\-touch candidate engagement.
* **Early Retention (90\-Day Stability):** Achieve \< 3% attrition within the first 90 days (ensuring cultural and technical “fit”).
* **Submittal\-to\-Interview Ratio:** 3:1 (Quality over quantity).
* **Weekly Throughput:** Average of 2–3 high\-quality offers extended per week across the desk.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* **The Automation Pedigree:** You likely currently work for a leading BPM organization or a high\-growth automation startup.
* **The Regional Map:** You strategically leverage India’s talent hubs—Gurgaon for voice and leadership capabilities, Noida for deep IT expertise, and emerging centers like Nashik and Vizag to drive high\-quality, cost\-efficient accounting operations.
* **The Network:** You have a “warm” database of mid\-to\-senior professionals in the Order\-to\-Cash (O2C) and Logistics space.

**Additional Requirements**
---------------------------


This opportunity enhances your work life balance with allowance for remote work. To be successful your computer hardware and internet must meet these minimum requirements:

* **Laptop or Desktop:**
	+ **Operating System:** Windows
	+ **Screen Size:** 14 Inches
	+ **Screen Resolution:** FHD (1920×1080\)
	+ **Processor:** I5 or higher
	+ **RAM:** Minimum 8GB (Must)
	+ **Type:** Windows Laptop
	+ **Software:** AnyDesk
* **Internet Speed:** 100 Mbps or higher

**About ARDEM**
---------------


ARDEM is a leading Business Process Outsourcing and Business Process Automation Service provider. For over twenty years ARDEM has successfully delivered business process outsourcing and business process automation services to our clients in USA and Canada. We are growing rapidly. We are constantly innovating to become a better service provider for our customers. We continuously strive for excellence to become the Best Business Process Outsourcing and Business Process Automation company.

---------

If you are contacted by any party claiming to represent ARDEM Incorporated offering work from home jobs – this is fraud. Please disregard and refer to ARDEM’s Careers page for all open job positions. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by such acts.

IntouchCX is a global leader in customer experience management, digital engagement, and AI and automation solutions. About the Job
  
  

The Learning \& Development Lead Trainer is responsible for designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs focused on leadership development, upskilling, and account\-specific role training. This role requires a dynamic individual who can engage diverse audiences, foster a growth mindset, and support the organization's strategic goals through effective learning initiatives.

title: Process Associate- Attendance & Workforce Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Process Associate**
================================

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  

**Company:** Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About Us**
============


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to transforming the healthcare industry. We take pride in being a reliable Healthcare Management partner. With several years of experience, we have perfected our end\-to\-end services in medical billing, A.R. management, and other essential healthcare operations.


We provide services to Harmony United Psychiatric Care, a US\-based Healthcare Company. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and continuous growth drives our success. As we expand, we are seeking a skilled and responsible **Process Associate** to join our team.

**Position Overview**
=====================


The **Process Associate** will be responsible for managing employee attendance systems, monitoring workplace compliance, maintaining access and security records, and supporting daily operational activities. This role requires close coordination with HR, IT, and Security teams to ensure smooth operations, accurate record\-keeping, and adherence to company policies.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Attendance Monitoring**
-------------------------

* Track and record employee attendance on a daily basis.
* Verify punctuality, absences, and late arrivals.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly attendance reports.
* Share attendance reports with HR and management teams.

**CCTV \& Surveillance Management**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor CCTV systems to ensure workplace safety and compliance.
* Report suspicious activities or security breaches immediately.
* Maintain logs of surveillance recordings as required.

**Login/Logout Management**
---------------------------

* Track employee login and logout times accurately.
* Maintain shift\-wise working hour records.
* Identify discrepancies in attendance or login/logout timings.
* Coordinate with HR for corrections and approvals.

**Alarm \& Access Control Management**
--------------------------------------

* Maintain and manage alarm system codes and access permissions.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive access information.
* Update access lists and alarm codes as per company policies.

**Operational Support**
-----------------------

* Assist HR and Operations teams with attendance\-related queries.
* Maintain records related to attendance, access control, and employee logs.
* Support onboarding activities related to system access setup.
* Assist during internal audits and compliance reviews.

**Reporting \& Documentation**
------------------------------

* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Maintain organized records of attendance, login/logout data, and access logs.
* Provide required reports during audits and internal reviews.

**Support \& Coordination**
---------------------------

* Coordinate with HR, IT, and Security teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide support to employees regarding attendance and access\-related concerns.
* Assist management in resolving attendance or access discrepancies.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor’s degree in **any discipline**.
* **1–3 years of experience** in process operations, attendance management, administration, or coordination roles.
* Experience working with attendance systems, reporting tools, or monitoring systems will be an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of workplace compliance and operational procedures.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.

**Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion**
======================================


Diversity, equality, and inclusion are fundamental to our success at HUMS. We actively promote diversity across all aspects of our organization and foster an inclusive culture where everyone has equal opportunities to grow and succeed.

**Work Schedule \& Benefits**
=============================

* Competitive salary (including EPF and ESIC)
* Health insurance
* Four\-day work week (**Monday – Thursday**)
* Opportunities for career growth and professional development
* Food and cab\-drop facilities available
* **Night Shift:** 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM
* **Work Mode:** Work From Office only

**Application Process**
=======================


Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and suitability for this role.


For any queries, please contact:  

**recruitment@hupcfl.com**

**Note:** Candidates are requested to contact between **4:45 PM to 3:45 AM IST**, Monday through Thursday.

88 Pictures is a leading global Animation \& VFX studio with footprints in Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Toronto. We take pride in telling compelling stories through visually stunning content while fostering an environment where creativity, innovation, and collaboration thrive.

* Documentation : Maintain the Solution Design Reference (SDR) and technical playbooks to ensure "Zero Trust" principles are applied to marketing data.

description:

Location: Nashik / Palghar/ Ahilyanagar/ Raigad

Travel: Regular local field travel, as per project requirements

Reporting To: Field Ecologist – Senior Manager

Employment Type: Full\-time

**Overview** 

The Monitoring \& Technical Assistant will work closely with Field Ecologists, ground teams, and project coordinators to support on\-ground monitoring and implementation activities under the guidance of technical experts. The role includes monitoring plantation/restoration performance (survival and growth), coordinating with nurseries on species availability and stock quality, and supporting technical documentation for field activities. This position requires regular fieldwork, data collection, and coordination with local teams and communities to ensure the smooth implementation of restoration activities and the effective delivery of awareness programs. The assistant will also support baseline and periodic monitoring, including nursery stock verification, plantation audits, basic soil and water observations, photographic documentation, geo\-tagged data collection, and assistance in community outreach and awareness sessions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\) Field Execution, Monitoring, and Data Collection** 

 Conduct regular field visits to the plantation and restoration sites.

 Coordinate and assist with executing pre\- and post\-plantation activities.

 Track sapling survival, growth parameters, and overall plantation health.

 Collect geo\-tagged photographs and record basic field observations for reporting.

 Coordinate with field staff for site access, monitoring schedules, and on\-ground updates.

**2\) Nursery Coordination**

 Support seed collection activities in coordination with local communities.

 Coordinate with nurseries to track plant material availability, quality, and dispatch.

 Maintain nursery status records and support verification of species identity and stock quality.

**3\) Technical and Project Support**

 Support technical fieldwork related to monitoring and documentation.

 Assist in baseline and periodic monitoring as guided by the technical team.

 Support project data compilation, record\-keeping, and reporting.

 Assist in data collection for theme\-based research activities.

**4\) Awareness and Community Engagement** 

 Support planning and execution of awareness/outreach sessions for communities and schools.

 Coordinate logistics for field\-based awareness programs.

 Assist in developing or preparing materials for awareness sessions.

**5\) Coordination and Field Presence** 

 Coordinate site visits with project teams and supervisors.

 Be present in the field on a daily basis, as required by the project.

**6\) Miscellaneous**

 Support field operations and other project\-related tasks as required.

**Eligibility \& Qualifications**

 B.Sc. / M.Sc. (preferably Environmental Science, Forestry, Botany, Biodiversity, or related fields).

 Freshers/newly graduated candidates are encouraged to apply.

 Prior volunteering/internship experience in field\-based projects will be an advantage.

 Comfortable with intensive fieldwork and outdoor conditions.

 Good coordination and communication skills.

 Valid two\-wheeler driving license.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

 Preference for candidates who can independently travel daily to field sites and handle physically demanding outdoor work in forest conditions.

 Strong interest in conservation, monitoring, and community awareness.

 Basic documentation and reporting skills.

 Basic MS\-Office skills.

**Requirements**

* Strong knowledge of end\-to\-end employee life\-cycle HR processes and employee relations practices.
* Demonstrates sound understanding of Indian labor laws and applies them confidently.
