* High attention to compliance orientation \- both internal and external compliances.
* Demonstrate clear ownership for outcomes out of employee lifecycle actions and compliance decisions.
* Sound judgment, confidentiality, and integrity.
* Effective communication (written and verbal) in English and in Hindi.
* Strong working exposure with MS Office tools – Word, PPT, Excel, Outlook, MS Teams.
* Ability to work under pressure, time constraints to ensure deadlines are met.
* Ability to travel occasionally.
* Ability to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles in daily work activities — the practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:
* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value.


**We Offer**
 In addition to competitive salary and benefits, we offer you an inspiring and challenging position, providing an excellent opportunity to contribute to our success. Our team\-oriented and international work environment fosters psychologically safe work environment, making it ideal for development\-minded individuals who thrive in a fast\-paced and dynamic setting. We value our employees and offer a range of learning opportunities, and you will have the chance to contribute to your personal and professional growth.

We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting\-edge technologies and services as well as mission\-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.
   

  

 Join the team – and lead the way with us!

**We are now looking for an India HR Manager to join our team.**
 As India HR Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring a compliant, efficient and customer‑focused HR operation for our India organisation. You will own day‑to‑day HR lifecycle processes, secure high‑quality HR data and documentation, and be a trusted partner to managers and employees on HR policies and standard employee relations matters.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

 HR Operations \& Case Management

* Handle basic employee relations cases, ensuring fair, consistent and compliant treatment; escalate complex or high‑risk issues to Senior P\&C Manager, HR Legal or Regional Head of EED as appropriate.


 Policy, Process and Documentation
   

  

* Draft and maintain India‑specific HR documentation (e.g. employment contracts, letters, addenda, employee handbook content, local templates) in line with global templates and Indian legislation.
* Review and approve HR transactions in Workday to ensure accuracy, proper controls and a robust audit trail.
* Run periodic data quality checks and corrections to maintain clean and reliable HR data for India.


 Implementation of Global Standards and Tools
   

  

* Localise and implement new global HR processes, standards and tools in India (e.g. new workflows, templates, self‑service content).
* Promote the use of Workday and self‑service tools among managers and employees to increase efficiency and consistency.


 Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Collaborate closely with India business leaders, P\&C Consultants and cross‑cutting EED teams on data quality sweeps, reporting and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work / rework and improve the employee experience in India HR processes over time.
* Provide feedback on India‑specific needs, regulatory changes and market practices to inform regional / global process design.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, Psychology or a related field required.
* Preferred: Postgraduate qualification in HR / Industrial Relations / Labour Law (e.g. MBA/PGDM in HR, MLW, MSW or equivalent).


 Professional Experience
   

  

* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, primarily in HR operations / HR Generalist / HRBP roles, with strong exposure to India employment lifecycle processes.
* Hands‑on experience managing HR operations for India, including onboarding, exits, payroll interface inputs, benefits administration, leave management and basic employee relations.
* Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying Indian labour laws and regulations (e.g. Shops and Establishments, Social Security Code, Gratuity, Provident Fund, ESI as applicable).
* Experience working in a multinational or matrix environment and collaborating with regional/global HR teams is an advantage.
* Prior experience with Workday or another enterprise HRIS is strongly preferred.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong practical knowledge of HR operations and employee relations in the India context.
* High attention to detail and strong commitment to data quality, documentation and compliance.
* Ability to interpret and apply policies, procedures and legal requirements in a clear, pragmatic and business‑oriented way.
* Customer‑oriented communication style; able to build trust and credibility with managers and employees.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a continuous‑improvement mindset.
* Comfort with HR systems and willingness to adopt new tools and ways of working.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
* Professional proficiency in English; proficiency in relevant local languages is an advantage.


**How to apply?**
 Use the ‘APPLY’ link before 30 April. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.
   

  

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process**
 All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.
   

  

**Join us in bringing people closer**
 GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We empower individuals with hearing loss to overcome real\-life challenges, enhance communication and collaboration within businesses, and deliver exceptional experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.
   

  

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.**

 Competitive salary based on experience and capability.

 Healthunbox is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.

 This is a fully on\-site role based in Narsinghpur, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates must be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be discussed for the right candidate.

 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for employees, counselors (managers) and business unit leadership on a range of talent\-related matters. * Strong clients focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels

* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups

* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We will introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

title: Associate - SOC
description:
**About River**
 River is an electric vehicle company building multi\-utility scooters. At River, we’re building scooters of tomorrow for the ambitious youth of today. Because we believe people only need two things to achieve success: the desire to make it to the top, and the means to get there.
   

  

 With our flagship product River Indie, SUVofScooters, is designed to help you get things done. Engineered to be a dependable ally on your road to success. We are backed by marquee international investors \- these are mobility focused funds backed by Yamaha Motors, Al\-Futtaim Automotive Group, Toyota VC and Maniv Mobility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Monitor both SIEM dashboards and the CrowdStrike Falcon console to detect potential security incidents, distinguishing between normal network noise and genuine threats
* Utilize CrowdStrike’s Process Execution Trees to trace the root cause of alerts, analyzing parent/child process relationships (e.g., "Why did Excel spawn PowerShell?") to identify malicious behavior.
* Apply CCNA\-level knowledge of the OSI Model and TCP/IP to correlate endpoint alerts with network logs, verifying if compromised hosts are communicating with Command \& Control (C2\) servers
* Move beyond simple signature matching by using Indicators of Attack (IOAs) to spot "Living off the Land" attacks (fileless malware) and mapping them to the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
* Act as the first responder for security alerts, classifying incidents based on severity and following the NIST Incident Response Lifecycle (Detection \& Analysis) to escalate verified threats
* Assist in cross\-referencing CVEs with CrowdStrike Spotlight data and apply CEH knowledge to understand how attackers might exploit unpatched vulnerabilities in the wild
* Analyze network packet headers (understanding the TCP 3\-Way Handshake and flags) to identify anomalies like SYN floods or port scanning
* Document investigation findings clearly in ticketing systems, detailing the "Who, What, When, and How" of the incident for senior analysts


**Ideal Candidate**
* B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Cybersecurity.
* Mandatory : CCNA (Strong Network Foundation) \& CompTIA Security\+ (Security Core)
* Fresher with active CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker) or CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)
* Conceptual understanding of EDR (Endpoint Detection \& Response) vs. Legacy Antivirus, and the benefits of cloud\-native, lightweight agents
* Deep understanding of Stateful vs. Stateless Firewalls, DMZ concepts, and packet filtering logic
* Strong familiarity with the Cyber Kill Chain, SQL Injection, XSS, and Phishing vectors
* Ability to explain the difference between IOCs (hashes, IPs) and IOAs (behaviors), and how to use Real Time Response (RTR) concepts
* Basic understanding of Symmetric/Asymmetric encryption, Hashing (SHA/MD5\), and PKI
* Willingness to work in rotational 24/7 shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays) to support a continuous monitoring Security Operations Center environment
* Strong analytical thinking, ability to "follow the breadcrumbs" during an investigation, and concise communication skills for incident reporting

 We are seeking a Skilled Network Engineer to join our IT team to design, implement, manage, and maintain Fortinet\-based network security infrastructure, including FortiSASE solutions. * Provide Tier 2 / Tier 3 network and security support and resolve escalated issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation including network configurations, security policies, and network diagrams.

**Position Title: Network Engineer**

 Lexmark is now a proud part of Xerox, bringing together two trusted names and decades of expertise into a bold and shared vision.
   

  

 When you join us, you step into a technology ecosystem where your ideas, skills, and ambition can shape what comes next. Whether you’re just starting out or leading at the highest levels, this is a place to grow, stretch, and make real impact—across industries, countries, and careers.

 Xerox is in search of a Network Security Engineer with a passion for designing, configuring, and enhancing a global enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation and maintenance of Xerox's enterprise network infrastructure and security policies. This role involves working with architects and business teams to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the enterprise network and connected systems. The Network Security Engineer will also be responsible for documenting procedures, coordinating implementations, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes.  Configuration and delivery of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
   

  

 Execution of network configuration processes such as firewall configurations, network security reports, network security solution configurations, network infrastructure hardening, and software/hardware licensing.
   

  

 Creation of logical diagrams, datacenter diagrams, and network operational procedures.
   

  

 Development and use of automation to execute repeatable tasks and processes.
   

  

 Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
   

  

 Collaboration with architecture and operational teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network operations and incident managers.
   

  

 Light travel may be required to deliver certain projects.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.

 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 2\-4 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Knowledge of network security technologies including Data\-Loss Prevention, Sandboxing, Network Antivirus, Cloud Application Security Brokers, Web Application Firewalls, AAA, and SSL Inspection.
   

  

 Knowledge of network security concepts such as Zero\-Trust and Least Privilege.
   

  

 Knowledge of network services, including IPSec, TLS, PKI, and logging/alerting systems.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting and automation (Python).
   

  

 Experience configuring Fortinet, Cisco, Infoblox, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Palo Alto, Checkpoint, and Zscaler.
   

  

 Familiar with NIST CSF, CIS, and ISO 27001 information security frameworks.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 Familiar with IT operational processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem, ITSM), development frameworks (Agile, SAFe), and service management frameworks (ITIL).

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+, CASP\+)

description:

 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. title: Technical Writer
description:
**Title** 




**Technical Writer** 




  





**Position Overview** 




 As a Technical Writer at LTSCT, you will be responsible for developing high\-quality product documentation that supports semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware solutions. This role requires the ability to understand complex technical concepts—spanning semiconductor technologies, associated subsystems, and software/firmware workflows—and translate them into clear, concise, user\-focused content.
 



 You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and globally distributed teams to gather information, structure documentation, and ensure consistency across deliverables. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong proficiency in structured authoring (DITA), single\-sourcing methodologies, and documentation lifecycle management using CCMS platforms. This role demands excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while consistently meeting deadlines.
 



**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




 Create complete, high\-quality product documentation from the ground up, adhering to organizational standards and project timelines.
 


* Update documentation to reflect changes in product versions, features, specifications, and industry standards.
* Use structured authoring methodologies (e.g., DITA) to create reusable content modules.
* Maintain a single source of truth for documentation to support consistent outputs across multiple formats.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product Management, and Quality teams to gather technical information and simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Review and edit documentation for grammar, accuracy, clarity, and technical correctness.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards such as IEEE, ISO, and JEDEC when documenting processes or specifications.
* Work effectively with both local and global teams across different time zones.
* Contribute to the development of standard diagrams, illustrations, videos, and presentations.
* Support special projects involving content review, proofreading, editing, and formatting for internal and external audiences.



**Qualifications \& Skills** 




 Bachelor’s degree in engineering (preferably ECE, EEE, CSE), Technical Communication, or a related field.
 


* 3\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, preferably in semiconductor hardware, software, and firmware documentation.
* Ability to design clear technical diagrams, architecture workflows, and visuals using Visio, Draw.io, or Adobe Illustrator.
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
* Exposure to documentation automation workflows (CI/CD publishing, Git branching, versioning pipelines, or scripted builds).
* Proven ability to manage documentation projects throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong experience with CCMS platforms and structured authoring methodologies to drive content reuse and maintain version control.



**Mandatory Skills** 








* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard documentation tools such as Oxygen XML Editor or equivalent XML/DITA\-based editors.
* Experience collaborating directly with SMEs such as design engineers, firmware developers, and validation teams to extract technical information.
* Hands\-on experience working with product engineering teams, understanding development lifecycles, sprints, and review workflows.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to validate technical content against design specifications, datasheets, and release notes.
* Strong command of English writing, editing, and technical communication standards.



**Preferred Skills** 








* Experience with CCMS\-based documentation tools, preferably Vasont Inspire.
* Experience writing and maintaining programming guides, user manuals, firmware guides, feature descriptions, and release documentation for semiconductors or SoC products.
* Experience documenting APIs, AT command sets, SDK workflows, or developer\-facing technical content.
* Familiarity with semiconductor terminology, chip architecture, block diagrams, and hardware development concepts.
* Knowledge of documentation automation, scripting, or Git\-based workflows.
* Ability to create multimedia content such as short videos, tutorials, or animations for product documentation.
* Familiarity with Cellular IoT technologies and standards (LTE/5G, NB\-IoT, Cat\-M, etc.) is desirable.
* Preferable if have the good knowledge on communication protocols like TCP,HTTP/S,MQTT/S,FTP

 Loch Corporate Services Private Limited is a professional services firm delivering a broad range of

 quality and compliance, Loch supports organisations seeking integrated support functions under a
 



 single, trusted provider. The firm maintains strict confidentiality standards, consistent quality
 



 controls, and seamless collaboration with client teams across multiple sectors.
 



  





**Purpose of the role** 




 The Junior Frontend Developer is responsible for building and maintaining the user\-facing elements of internal tools and client\-facing web applications. Working under the direction of the Lead Developer, this role translates design specifications and business requirements into responsive, accessible, and performant interfaces. The position suits a developer with a strong visual sense, solid foundational skills in modern frontend technologies, and a genuine interest in delivering polished user experiences across devices and platforms.
 



  





**Responsibilities and duties** 




 • Build responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces from design mockups,

 • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using modern frontend frameworks and
 



 libraries (e.g. React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, Svelte).
 



 • Implement pixel\-accurate layouts using HTML5, CSS3, and preprocessors or utility
 



 frameworks (e.g. SASS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap).
 



 • Ensure cross\-browser and cross\-device compatibility across desktop, tablet, and mobile
 



 viewports.
 



 • Implement client\-side state management, routing, and data fetching patterns in line with the
 



 project’s architectural approach.
 



 • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs (REST, GraphQL) and handle
 



 asynchronous data flows, error states, and loading patterns.
 



 • Contribute to component library development, design system adoption, and reusable UI
 



 pattern creation.
 



 • Optimise page load times, rendering performance, and asset delivery through techniques
 



 such as lazy loading, code splitting, and image optimisation.
 



 • Follow web accessibility standards (WCAG) and implement semantic HTML, ARIA attributes,
 



 and keyboard navigation support.
 



 • Support on\-page SEO requirements including meta tags, structured data, and performance
 



 benchmarks.
 



 • Write unit tests and component tests using frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library,
 



 Cypress, or Playwright.

 style guides.

 into functional interfaces.

 within agreed timelines.
 



 • Maintain documentation for components, design patterns, and frontend development
 



 processes.
 



 • Participate in sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives as part of the development
 



 workflow.
 



  





**Key deliverables** 




 • User interfaces built to specification, responsive across devices, and accessible to WCAG
 



 standards.
 



 • Frontend components developed, tested, and integrated with backend services.
 



 • Page performance optimised against agreed benchmarks.
 



 • UI bugs and cross\-browser issues identified and resolved within agreed timeframes.
 



 • Component documentation and frontend process documentation maintained.
 



 Compliance and confidentiality
 



 • Adhere to all organisational policies, procedures, and codes of conduct as applicable to the
 



 role.
 



 • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality in relation to client matters, internal
 



 operations, and sensitive business information.
 



 • Handle all personal and professional data in accordance with applicable privacy and data
 



 protection requirements.
 



 • Follow secure development practices and immediately report any actual or suspected
 



 security incidents, data breaches, or compliance concerns to the Lead Developer or India
 



 Director.
 



  





**Key relationships** 




 • Lead Developer
 



 • Backend developers and Cloud Engineer
 



 • Designers and product stakeholders
 



 • India Director
 



  





**Essential skills** 




 • Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6\+).
 



 • Familiarity with one or more modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue.js,
 



 Angular, or Svelte.
 



 • An eye for design detail and a genuine interest in delivering clean, intuitive user interfaces.
 



 • Working knowledge of responsive design principles and mobile\-first development.
 



 • Exposure to version control systems (e.g. Git) and collaborative development workflows.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
**Who are We?**




 Vijya Fintech is a 25\+ year fintech platform built purposefully for 2000\+ active users, including advisors, distributors, brokers, and MFDs, to scale ₹2L\+ Cr AUM with automation, intelligence, and speed. Managing 8L\+ investors, it transforms a financial intermediary from a transactional fund operator into a highly organised, data\-driven financial advisor: equipped with the tools, intelligence, and client experience layer to deliver genuine financial solutions. Core capabilities include full AUM visibility, client behaviour forecasting, attrition prediction, and AI\-powered portfolio realignment action plans: all in one platform.
 



  





**What we do:**




 At Vijaya Fintech, we are on a mission to build the Amazon of financial services—a one\-stop destination where every financial tool and product is available at your fingertips.
 



  





 MIDASX is India’s AI\-powered, white\-label SaaS application and multi\-asset marketplace , built for advisors, distributors, brokers, and MFDs to scale AUM with automation, intelligence, and speed.is a powerful digital platform that helps financial advisors, distributors, and brokers grow their business faster. It uses smart technology (AI) to handle everything from signing up new clients to managing their investments and creating reports.
 



 By automating the boring paperwork and providing intelligent insights, MIDASX allows professionals to focus on their clients and significantly increase their earnings and efficiency.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are looking for a dynamic HR / People Operations Manager to join our fast\-growing Fintech team. In this role, you will be the backbone of our human capital strategy, balancing the high\-speed growth of a tech startup with the rigorous compliance standards of the financial services industry.
 



  





 You will lead the charge in attracting top\-tier engineering talent, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring our people strategy aligns with our mission to ......
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  




* Talent Acquisition: Own the full\-cycle recruitment process, specifically targeting "Fintech" talent\-professionals who understand both software scaling and financial regulations.
* Onboarding \& Culture: Design a world\-class onboarding experience that integrates new hires into our "Security First" culture from day one.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all HR practices comply with local labor laws and financial industry requirements (including background checks, KYC training, and data privacy standards).
* Total Rewards: Manage and optimize our compensation philosophy, including salary benchmarking, equity/stock option grants, and comprehensive benefits packages.
* Performance Management: Implement agile performance review cycles and career development frameworks to retain high\-performing technical and financial staff.
* People Analytics: Use data\-driven insights to monitor headcount, turnover, and diversity, reporting directly to the leadership team.



  





**Qualifications**



* Experience: 3–5\+ years of HR/People Ops experience, preferably within a Fintech, Insurtech, or high\-growth SaaS environment.
* Knowledge: Strong understanding of equity/ESOP structures and the legalities of hiring in a regulated environment.
* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate complex conversations between engineering, legal, and executive teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (SHRM/PHR certification is a plus).



  





**Why do you like working with us?**



* Skip the "Beta" Phase: We’ve been around for 25 years, but we operate like a Day 1 startup. You get the stability of a legacy firm with the "move fast and break things" energy of a fintech.
* Direct Equity in Decisions: In most places, you’re a "contributor." Here, you’re a principal. Your logic doesn't go through five layers of approval; it goes into production.
* Complex over Cosmetic: If you want a job where you just change button colors, this isn't it. We solve "how do I move billions of rupees seamlessly" problems.
* Joining Bonus: Joining us within 30 days of your offer isn't just a win for us, it' s a win for your bank account. Consider it an immediate ROI on your career move that will be discussed at the time of receiving the offer letter .

description:
Designation: Manager


Location: India Jharkhand Harsh Plaza, Giridhi


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------


1\) Job Purpose: *Write the purpose for which the job exists (in 2\-3 lines)* (Max 1325 Characters)

  

The purpose of this job is to plan area (city/ branch) sales and business growth with the Territory Head (Sales) and achieve set targets through the team while complying with sales processes and guidelines at all times. It takes joint approval decisions with Risk counterpart as per approval matrix, and works with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure portfolio health. It works to support business profitability by addressing underperformance, adopting process improvements, capitalizing on channel optimization opportunities, etc. It intervenes as required in specific cases/ exceptions and helps address bottlenecks for the achievement of sales targets, hand\-holding team members on complex cases. It also drives cross\-selling across ABFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per regional plans and unique client requirements.

  


3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section ((Max 3975 Characters)

 **Organizational Context**


Key Aspects:

* **As the debt arm of Aditya Birla Capital (ABC), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid\-sized Banks and NBFCs.**
* **The company has a well\-defined vision of being one of the most reputed and material financiers within the lending space – spread across Retail HNI and corporate clientele. It has made significant investments in process and system infrastructure towards preparing for the next level of growth and are one of the only financial entities certified for ISO 9001:2008 across all business processes. Spread across 18 cities, it plans on further diversifying its risk and revenue mix through expansion into new geographies and new product segments allowing customers a one\-window shop for all their financing needs.**
* **Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Secured Micro Loan Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield and profit segment.**

**Job Context**


Key Aspects:

* **The Secured Micro Loan Business segment product line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of Small Businesses and individuals, via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, with collateral.**
* **Offerings comprise Secured Micro Loan to self\-employed individuals/ non\-individual entities, with end use of funds (Working capital requirement, business expansion etc.) to be ascertained during the loan appraisal process.**
* **The business is highly retail in nature, characterized by high transaction volumes, smaller ticket sizes, and significantly higher spread and profit margins (up to four times that of Secured Lending products)**
* **Given the Secured Micro Loan nature of loans disbursed, the business also entails stringent controls and monitoring to ensure portfolio health and quality at all times**
* **While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are key business objectives.**
* **Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to customers**
* **Understanding of product market characteristics such as connector relationship management, region specific occupations/trade, local financial preferences and practices are important to gain competitive advantage while structuring loans and identifying leads.**
* The AH (Sales) – ABFL is responsible for achieving sales targets as agreed with the Territory Head (Sales) – ABFL, in terms of targeted book size, profitability, growth \& customer service objectives.

 **Key Challenges**

* To deliver on operational the assigned coverage area in a differentiated manner considering local factors, channel dynamics and consumer preferences, that can withstand competitive pressures on the ground
* To grow the business while remaining cognizant of competitive realities in the following areas plan in:
* Market linked product
* Market average IRR \& processing fee levels
* To originate and increase market share in assigned coverage area against stiff competition, overcoming competitive pressures borne out of better established networks, price undercutting, etc.
* To establish a strong local network and leverage the same to generate business leads, and also identify opportunities for cross sell with existing customers
* To constantly upgrade financial \& operational know how of self and team members on efficient loan processing, effective negotiation and relationship building for maintaining credibility and profitable target achievement

title: Head - Manufacturing, Linen Fabric
description:
Designation: General Manager


Location: India West Bengal JST, Rishra


Organization: Cellulosic Fibre \& Textiles

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### ***Job Purpose***


To lead and drive the Linen Fabric Operations function by defining and executing operational strategy, and by planning, organizing, and controlling end\-to\-end fabric operations to ensure timely delivery of linen fabrics that meet customer requirements for quality and quantity. The role is accountable for achieving predefined production targets within planned cost and realization parameters, ensuring safe working practices, and optimizing utilization of manpower, materials, and machine resources to deliver consistent operational performance.

#### ***Job Context \& Major Challenges***


Linen is a Labour intensive natural fibre to manufacture and is difficult to maintain consistent quality parameters. It is necessary to source best of the raw materials and to adapt best manufacturing process and systems to maintain the standards.
 There is a scarcity for talents in Indian textile industry to produce this kind of critical fabrics. It is a big challenge for us to search for the talent and to train, develop and retain them.
 We as a premium supplier of Linen, a critical fibre to handle should upgrade ourselves with new technology trends to achieve product excellence at the lowest overall cost.
 Being new suppliers coming into the market, reviewing \& interpreting market expectations and seasonal preferences for developing new product ranges is a big challenge in terms of production without affecting the efficiency or quality of the product as well as the cost effectiveness of production.
 To develop and weave finest count product, to create entry barrier to keep a void between the new entrants in the high potential linen market.
 The Growth plan in fabric production requires technical knowledge with good commercial acumen so as to control the complete supply chain and process effectiveness right from planning of raw materials to delivery of finish fabrics.
 The fabric production which has targeted of 90 Lac Meters in 2015\-16 has further growth expectations of 15% year on year.
 To manage job vendors and to evaluate them periodically to maintain the high standards of the group and take necessary corrective actions as and when required.  

Challenges:* Ensuring best quality
* Cost optimization
* Manpower handling

#### **Key Result Areas**

**Key Result Areas**

  

Supporting Actions

 **Production Planning \& control**

  

* Plan and prioritize the activities of weaving, processing, yarn dyeing and warehouse in coordination with PPC dept
* Identify the area of losses and taking corrective action regularly.
* Analyze, review and control production of fabric to achieve highest production efficiencies including machine utilization.
* Explore new ideas and evaluate them for viability to implement in plant to reduce cycle time, production cost
 **Operations**

  

* Weaving: Ensure smooth Weaving operations (Winding, Warping, Loom shed and Maintenance)
* Dyeing \& Processing: Ensure all activities related to dyeing, preparatory, and finishing section in the dye house and fabric process house within the defined standard of time, quality.
* Ware House: Ensure all activities for the inspection, mending, and packing of fabric in the Finished warehouse, creation of samples, and rejected good reprocessing.
* Process Control: Ensure and monitor all process controls \& parameters, in the fabric processing section. Ensure execution of SOPs for new processes as and when required.
 **Quality**

  

* Analyze and review the quality reports of each section –weaving, processing, yarn dyeing \& packing
* Identify \& eliminate bottle necks in all activities in the Linen Fabric processes.
* Daily Review of quality of final product and direct corrective actions
 **Production Safety and Sustainability**

  

* Maintain Waste Intensity, Energy Intensity, and Water Intensity as per sustainability guidelines
* Implementation of HIRA SOP and maintain good housekeeping \& compliance safe working practices in the plant.
* Ensure Safe Working condition and practices in respective area with zero tolerances.
 **Implementation of WCM and IMS**

  

* Study world’s best manufacturers and compare existing quality system / work practices to analyze the reasons for gaps in quality
* Prepare plan of action, and organize trials for improvement in quality levels
* Direct and monitor the implementation of IMS Quality management norms in the Plant
 **Capability Building**

  

* Motivate and guide team members and create a space for Idea sharing and implementing
* Evaluating performances of sections and Identify training needs for section \& work with HR dept for capability development.
* Groom GET/DET in technical aspects and develop talent pipeline

title: Specialist Senior, Talent Acquisition
description:
Overview:

Summary Statement: Under supervision, the Talent Acquisition Specialist Sr. is responsible for planning, development, evaluation, implementation, and execution of a recruiting strategy for assigned positions to secure the best talent for the Company. Includes, but is not limited to sourcing, screening, interviewing, extending offers and onboarding of candidates for open positions. This position will partner with the Human Resources and Hiring Managers to hire the best talent for the Company.
Responsibilities:

Representative Duties:  

* Develops and administers staffing \& recruiting programs, working with Hiring Manager to document requirements of job openings as required.
* Develops innovative, creative, and proactive recruitment strategies to meet the business needs of each Hiring Manager.
* Leverages various resources to source qualified candidates using the internet, media, formal/information networks, social networking etc., to source a diverse candidate pool.
* Responsible for pre\-screening resumes, conducting phone and in person/virtual interviews to evaluate and provided recommendations to the Hiring Manager.
* Manage candidate relationships, ensuring a positive candidate experience from initial contact through onboarding.
* Works with agencies to recruit for temporary or contract openings, providing performance feedback on all recruiting agencies/sources.
* Fosters a pipeline for key or frequently available positions on a continuous basis.
* Develops, supports, and maintains college recruitment and intern \& graduate trainee program.
* Participates in recruitment and selection projects and recommends changes to the process to increase attraction and retention of highly qualified candidates.
* Maintains ongoing awareness of the Company’s business and customer groups in order to effectively recruit the best talent.
* Complies with state, and local regulations by administering employment practices within standard operating procedures.
* Works closely with HR partners and hiring managers to develop and execute strategic talent acquisition plans.
* Advises and educates hiring managers on best practices for interviewing and selection processes.
* Operates independently and devises creative strategies to attract and secure top talent.
* Support other Human Resources functions as necessary.
* Additional duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

Requirements:* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field
* Minimum 5 years of experience demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of recruiting best practices.
* Proven ability to identify, establish, and access candidate sources to successfully fill career opportunities within established metrics
* Able to use professional concepts and apply company policies/procedures to work on problems/issues of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors.
* Computer literacy required. Proficiency in Microsoft Office preferred.
* Able to exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices to establish priorities and determine appropriate action in a fast\-paced, multi\-task environment.
* Solid knowledge of federal and state laws regarding employment practices.
* Clear and concise verbal and written communications.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Associates at all levels

* Strong project management and organizational skills

description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.


We are looking for an Associate Talent Acquisition Partner professional with 0–2 years of experience to join our growing Talent Acquisition team in India. This role is primarily focused on volume hiring and in\-house recruitment, supporting the TA team in scaling hiring across multiple functions. You will work closely with the TA Manager and Senior TA Partners, assisting them in executing end\-to\-end hiring activities and ensuring a smooth and efficient recruitment process.



This is a great opportunity for someone eager to build a career in recruitment, gain exposure to high\-volume hiring, and work across diverse roles and business functions in a fast\-paced environment.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Support volume hiring initiatives across multiple roles and business functions.
* Assist TA Manager and Senior TA Partners in day\-to\-day recruitment activities.
* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, scheduling, and candidate communication.
* Support hiring for Mid\-level, Interns, Freshers, and Apprentice roles.
* Work on hiring across Core Engineering, Product, Support, Services, and select Business roles.
* Assist in Apprentice and Internship hiring programs, including coordination and candidate engagement.
* Maintain and update candidate information in ATS (Greenhouse).
* Coordinate interviews across stakeholders and ensure timely follow\-ups.
* Help in maintaining a strong talent pipeline for ongoing and future hiring needs.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.

  


**Requirements**


* Experience: 0–2 years in recruitment, HR, or related fields (freshers with strong interest in TA are welcome).
* Good understanding of recruitment processes; exposure to volume hiring is a plus.
* Strong interest in in\-house recruitment and scaling hiring operations.
* Good communication skills in English (written and verbal).
* Familiarity with ATS tools (preferably Greenhouse) is an advantage.
* Ability to multitask, stay organized, and manage multiple requests.
* Detail\-oriented with strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Eagerness to learn and work in a collaborative, fast\-paced, and global environment.
* **Education:** Bachelor's Degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
